SELECT
FROM EVENT_NAMETAG_LOG N WHERE N.PARTICIPANT_SEQ = #{participantSeq} ORDER BY N.PRINT_TIME DESC

SELECT
FROM EVENT_NAMETAG_LOG N INNER JOIN EVENT_PARTICIPANT P ON N.PARTICIPANT_SEQ = P.SEQ INNER JOIN SURVEY_USER U ON P.SURVEY_USER_SEQ = U.SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} ORDER BY N.PRINT_TIME DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT_NAMETAG_LOG N INNER JOIN EVENT_PARTICIPANT P ON N.PARTICIPANT_SEQ = P.SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq}

SELECT IFNULL(N.TEMPLATE_TYPE, 'DEFAULT') as templateType, COUNT(*) as printCount FROM EVENT_NAMETAG_LOG N INNER JOIN EVENT_PARTICIPANT P ON N.PARTICIPANT_SEQ = P.SEQ WHERE P.EVENT_SEQ = #{eventSeq} GROUP BY N.TEMPLATE_TYPE
